where: the daemon's edit build, between `lower workspace` and the binary's `unit names`
what: In a body edit's build (26 to 36 ms of spans on the VM) 5 to 11 ms pass between `lower workspace` ending and `unit names` starting in which the workers' spans add to under 1 ms; no span names the stretch, `path_links` has no rows for the build, and it is the largest part of the edit.
cost: the live edit is 30 ms where its named parts add to about 15; nobody can say from the profile what the rest is
cause: not found: the time is on the daemon's loop thread, whose steps are not spans
whys: why no span: the loop's own steps are counted only when one runs past 20 ms (`loop stalled`)
property: time on a thread the profile does not cover
class: unnamed time: a stretch of a build that no span, wait or critical-path row accounts for
prevention: rule slow-is-p0-traced; a gate check that a build's named time (spans on its critical path) covers its wall time within a few percent
